d: Bijepi aur shiromni akali dal ek bar phir sath aa gae hain. donon partiyon ne 2027 ke panjab vidhanasbha chunav men milkar utarne ka ailan kiya hai. kabhi karib dhaee dashak tak panjab ki rajniti par asar rakhne vala yah gathbandhan 2020 men tin krishi kanunon ke virodh ke bad tut gaya tha. lekin ab donon dalon ko phir ek-dusre ki zarurat kyon mahsus ho rahi hai?
